title: Recent advances in cement-based thermoelectric devices
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4220-4237
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00567A, Review Article
Jian Wei, Yiwei Liu, Dongdong Liu, Enhao Lv, Xueke Lei
